Transcription.// Notes: Per Voice Live 2025-10-01 spec, only these models are supported with gpt-realtime: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize. azure-speech is NOT supported with gpt-realtime. whisper-1 chosen as default: more stable on short Danish phone-call utterances. gpt-4o-transcribe has lower benchmark WER but well-documented truncation issues on short audio in production.
